title_en: Call for Applications: 2027–2028 Israeli Government Scholarship
summary: The National Institute for International Education (NIIED) invites interested students to apply for the 2027–2028 Israeli Government Scholarship for degree, postdoctoral, research and summer language programs. Applicants must send one set of original application documents by post to the Academic Section of the Embassy of Israel in Seoul so that they arrive by Friday, 15 January 2027. In-person submission is not accepted.
applies_to: Any interested student; applying is voluntary. Eligibility requirements are set out in Attachment 1, which was not read for this translation.

dates.what: Application deadline (applications must arrive at the Embassy of Israel by this date; postal submission only)
Scholarship period covered by this call

conditions: Eligibility requirements and other details are given in Attachment 1, which was not read for this translation.
Only applications that arrive by 15 January 2027 will be accepted.
Applications may not be submitted in person; they must be sent by post.
One set of original application documents must be submitted.
The front of the envelope must be marked "정부장학금 지원서" (Government Scholarship Application).

For master's, doctoral, postdoctoral and research programs, the scholarship covers 50% of tuition up to a limit of USD 6,000, basic medical insurance, and a living allowance of USD 1,000 for 8 months.
For the summer language program (3.5 weeks), the scholarship covers full tuition, dormitory, basic medical insurance and a modest living allowance.
steps: Read the attachment "2027-2028 이스라엘 정부장학금 안내.pdf" (Attachment 1) for eligibility requirements and details.
Complete the application form provided in the attachment "지원서 양식.pdf" and prepare one set of original application documents.
Mark the front of the envelope "정부장학금 지원서" (Government Scholarship Application).

Send the documents by post to: Academic Section, Embassy of Israel, 18th floor, Cheonggye Hanguk Building, 11 Cheonggyecheon-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul (postal code 03187), so that they arrive by Friday, 15 January 2027.
For questions, contact the Academic Section of the Embassy of Israel; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
2027–2028 Israeli Government Scholarship Selection

The National Institute for International Education has announced the selection of 2027–2028 Israeli Government Scholarship recipients as follows. Interested students are encouraged to apply.

A. Programs: master's and doctoral degree programs, postdoctoral program (Post-Doc), research program, summer language program

B. Eligibility requirements and other details: see [Attachment 1] (the attachment was not read for this translation)

C. Scholarship benefits
1) Master's and doctoral degree programs, postdoctoral program, research program: tuition (50% of tuition, up to USD 6,000), basic medical insurance, living allowance (USD 1,000, for 8 months)
2) Summer language program (3.5 weeks): full tuition, dormitory, basic medical insurance, a modest living allowance

D. Application method and deadline: Friday, 15 January 2027 [applications arriving by 15 January will be accepted; in-person submission is not accepted]
1) Application method: send one set of the original application documents to the Embassy by post
2) Submit to: Academic Section, Embassy of Israel in Korea, 18th floor, Cheonggye Hanguk Building, 11 Cheonggyecheon-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul (postal code 03187)
※ Write "정부장학금 지원서" (Government Scholarship Application) on the front of the envelope.

E. Inquiries: Academic Section, Embassy of Israel in Korea (the phone number and email address are given in the original notice)

Attachments (2) (not read for this translation):
- 2027-2028 이스라엘 정부장학금 안내.pdf (2027–2028 Israeli Government Scholarship Guide) (217 KB)
- 지원서 양식.pdf (Application Form) (326 KB)
